title: Ancient Nubian temple faience workshop reveals links between craft production and royal power
description: Archaeologists have discovered a faience workshop at a major temple complex in the ancient Nubian capital of Napata, showing how the rulers of ancient Kush used specialized craft production to reinforce royal power.
